{{Infobox quest |image =Reserv Banner.png |icon = |given by =[[Prapor]] |location =[[Reserve]], [[Woods]] |LL requirement =3 |LL quests =1 |previous = |leads to = |related = }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|Salutations! An important assignment has just come from the high-ups. Top priority and all that jazz. There's a path from Priozersk to the Reserve base, and our guys need communication in those parts urgently. The path? Ah well, I'll share it with you, but make sure nobody else knows about it! When the Contract Wars were in full swing, some artisan managed to lay a path parallel to our road. We tracked the guy down and started interrogating him on who he was working for, what kind of mission he was on, you know the drill. We thought we'd captured a spy! Yet he kept calling himself a mushroom picker and grinning like a moron. We wanted to send him to headquarters. But at night our mushroom picker disappeared, no one saw him again after that. So, with your help, we'll build a communication line along this path, and you'll be responsible for the equipment. You'll deliver a part of it to the place, go to the Reserve base, and leave the second part there.}} ==Objectives== * Stash a [[Military cable]] at the boulder next to RUAF gate on [[Woods]] * Use the transit from [[Woods]] to [[Reserve]] * Stash a [[Bulbex cable cutter]] at the sandbags next to LAV III above the storage warehouse on [[Reserve]] ==Rewards== * +28,000 [[EXP]] * [[Prapor]] Rep '''+0.75''' * 275,000 Roubles ** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 {{quote|Your country will be proud of you, soldier! But the fact that the Scavs started roaming around this path worries me a bit...
